verdict.rationale: Ashby ships in-product AI insights. Ashby Assistant is a chat agent that analyzes pipelines and returns updates with candidate sentiment, current stage and interview concerns, within existing permissions. AI candidate rediscovery matches existing candidates to job criteria and surfaces key signals, and the AI Notetaker summarizes interviews. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and documentation of proactive, unprompted suggestions beyond on-demand queries and rediscovery signals.
